title: Record the integer idle histogram
body:
## Summary
- The selected complex profile leaves an idle mass of 1646, and the integer minimum at both bracket ends is 32 children of rank 51 plus one child of rank 14.
- The lower endpoint is strictly below one, the upper endpoint is strictly above one, and the selected saving sits below the bracket. No new kappa.
